question: 20261028-0433-expand-inference-u06-q03: should the China-ecosystem inference records filed under compute (compute/siliconflow, compute/z-ai-glm-flash, compute/alibaba-cloud-model) get inference-topic records?
why: no inference-topic record exists for them, so an inference query misses them; compute/deepseek-api is proposed as a duplicate_of inference/deepseek-api, which is the home of the offer. The same pair also shows derived flags that disagree (inference/deepseek-api has needs_phone yes only because its detail names a +86 number for the enterprise bank-transfer lane, and compute/deepseek-api had needs_card no); a discover run or a re-file by a rules session is the next step
